description: This bar chart illustrates the sample count distribution across four essay genres—Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository—with each genre having two bars representing the 'Open' category (light blue) and the 'Closed' category (light pink), as indicated by the legend. The horizontal axis lists the genres in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis, labeled 'Sample Count', ranges from 0 to 120 in increments of 20 on a linear scale. For each genre, the 'Open' bar is light blue and the 'Closed' bar is light pink; the exact sample counts are labeled atop each respective bar. The 'Argumentative' genre shows 79 samples for 'Open' and 122 for 'Closed'. The 'Narrative' genre has 80 for 'Open' and 87 for 'Closed'. The 'Descriptive' genre displays 68 for 'Open' and 100 for 'Closed'. The 'Expository' genre has 62 for 'Open' and 130 for 'Closed'. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the genres listed on the x-axis. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining beyond their color coding and numerical labels.
